text: Malyna Jurelette is a Breton traveling merchant. She is found on the road east of Koeglin Village.
Mandel is a Breton residing in the Alik'r Camp, in Alcaire Castle. He can be found walking about the camp.
Manthir is a Bosmer residing inside his house in Woodhearth. He owes a debt to Cold-Eyes.

Marapa is a senche-tiger residing at the Laughing Moons Plantation in Khenarthi's Roost. She is supposed to clear the plantation of rats, but it appears she is too lazy to do so after consuming rats who have been feeding on moon sugar. Her handler is Cinder-Tail. Her sisters are Gobani and Afeh.
Malan Dalothran is a Dunmer priest found inside the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Malbirra is a Khajiit found in Elden Root, Mournhold, and Wayrest where crafting writ items are delivered in each of the cities.
Malori Hlaalu is a Dunmer member of House Hlaalu residing in the city of Mournhold.
Malakeh is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild residing in the town of Bergama.
Marbruk Guard is a character residing in the city of Marbruk.
Malthagros is a Bosmer fence who operates out of the Evermore Outlaws Refuge in the city of Evermore.
Malkar is a Altmer member of the Fighters Guild residing in the Fighters Guildhall in the city of Ebonheart.
Malthor is a Bosmer fisherman residing in the port city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost.
Maormer Sailors are Maormer members of the Sea Vipers found at Cat's Eye Quay.
Malaniel is a Bosmer residing in her house in the city of Silvenar.
Mandolion is a Bosmer merchant residing in the Western Elsweyr Gate in Cyrodiil.
Mangeth is a Bosmer siege merchant and member of the Aldmeri Dominion found at the Western Elsweyr Gate in Cyrodiil.
Malvi Tedala is a Dunmer afflicted with the Llodos Plague. She is found in the camp for those affected located inside the catacombs underneath Quarantine Serk.
Maldetuile is an Altmer in who resides in the city of Skywatch. She can be found in the Barbed Hook Tavern.
Mamir is a Redguard Magister of the Mages Guild residing in Fort Amol.
Maniz is a Khajiit residing inside Clan Mother Shuzura's house in S'ren-ja.
Manone Troivois is a Breton residing in the town of Wind Keep.
Marbet Hemmet is a Breton found at the Wayside Inn in the town of Wind Keep.
Mar-Zak is a Goblin shaman of the Bonesnap Tribe. He is one of the bosses of the Bonesnap Ruins.
Malihaz-do is a Khajiit found inside the ruins of Shada's Tear in Craglorn.
Manadzur is a Khajiit slave found in the pens of Kragenmoor.
Malachite is a cat who can be found sitting on a bookshelf inside the Skywatch Mages Guild. He is one of many cats residing at the Skywatch guild.
Marble is a cat accompanying Kathariel outside the Skywatch Mages Guild.
Many-Eyes-Watching is an Argonian member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Riften.
Marald Meadblood is a Nord stablemaster working at his family stables in Riften.
Mamma Aralosi is a Dunmer found at the Deepcrag Den. She cooks and provides for the miners working there.
Malira is a Khajiit residing in the town of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Maraamun is a Nord worshipper of Sanguine found at Sanguine's Demesne.
Malarel is a Dunmer and the current champion of The Sorcerer Division at the Thizzrini Arena.
Many-Eyes is a Argonian residing in the Thizzrini Arena, Reaper's March.
Malkish is a Khajiit patron of the Five Claws Inn in Woodhearth.

Marcella Stenck is a Breton found aboard The Blasted Breton docked in the town of Alten Corimont. She is distrustful of the locals, suspecting them of having stolen several barrels from her, but continues to trade there due to good payment.
Malirzzaka is a Khajiit guild trader. He operates his kiosk, Culled from the Crypt, at the Bangkorai Pass Wayshrine.
Marcellus Atius is an Imperial fisher found in the city of Orsinium, a bit south of Scarp Keep. He has no unique dialogue.
Malubeth the Scourger is a Harvester boss found in Wayrest Sewers II in . She may drop Malubeth's Stinger.
Marasadra is a Khajiit found at Zetisha's Tack and Tackle in Arenthia.
Malangwe is an Altmer member of the Veiled Heritance. She is posing as a teacher at the College of Aldmeri Propriety.

Marcella Ammianus is an Imperial priestess of Mara found near Fort Sphinxmoth. Along with a group of guards, they tracked a group of bandits that robbed artefacts from their temple back to their hideout.
Maraka is an Orsimer mystic in charge of The Gem Forge in Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar.
Malsorr is a Nord armorer of the Ebonheart Pact. He works and sells his wares at the Merchant House at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Marasa Hlarar is a Dunmer patron of the Mudcrab and Suds in Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Mangitaale is an Altmer traveling merchant found on the road northeast of the Ayleid ruins of Torinaan.
Marafi is a crazed Khajiit member of the Fist of Thalmor team that went into the Wilding Run.
Malfinir is a Bosmer member of the Vinedusk Rangers found at their headquarters in Vinedusk Village.
Malgorin is a Bosmer found resting in a bed in the Salted Wings Tavern in Vulkhel Guard.
Manenlir is a Bosmer member of the Vinedusk Rangers. He is found at their headquarters in Vinedusk Village.
Marantar is a Bosmer alchemist and member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Velyn Harbor, where he sells his wares at his stall, The Greenglass Vial.

Maldred Gagnon is a Breton vampire working on behalf of House Montclair. Prior to that, he was the mayor of Moira's Hope. He was approached and offered with the opportunity of becoming a vampire. He accepted and in exchange, he allowed his people to be transformed into mindless bloodiends, adding to House Montclair's forces.
Marane Mallon is a Breton merchant. He was part of the fleet of ships that was heading for Orsinium that crashed on the coast of Wrothgar.
Marane Sterrien is a Breton residing in the large house near the bridge leading to Bangkorai.
Marcelle Stenric was a Breton member of House Dorell. Her spirit can be found in their resting place, Tribulation Crypt.
Marcellyne Cine is a Breton guarding the entrance to Kerbol's Hollow.
Marcelyn Andrese is a Breton noble in the Crossroads Tavern in Belkarth, Craglorn.
Maralie Rendas is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Arand.
Mallius Falto is an Imperial priest of Arkay. He is found dying next to a cursed urn within Broken Tusk.
Marcellus Bursio is an Imperial member of the Worm Cult. He is part of the cell encountered in Trolhetta.
Malisu is a Khajiit found at the Maw of Lorkhaj. He was corrupted by the Dro-m'Athra when they invaded the temple and can be seen slowly undergoing the transformation into one himself.
Manradh is a Khajiit laborer of the Mages Guild, sweeping the floors at the branch in Abah's Landing.
Mansa is a Khajiit fisherwoman found at the lake east of Fort Dragonclaw. Mansa has a friend, Hannura, whom lives in Chorrol.
Marali is a Khajiit member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found at the Western Elsweyr Gate.
Malinanta is a Wispmother in . She has made her lair within Hrota Cave in Gold Coast.
Malur Rethan is a Dunmer residing in Balmora. He is a member of the House Hlaalu and a co-owner of Vassir-Didanat ebony mine along with his brother, Benar Rethan.
Malathan is a Khajiit artisan residing in Pilgrim's Approach in Vivec City. He offers no unique dialogue.
Maralfar Foxbite is a Nord beggar found at various locations throughout Greenshade.
Manwe Relthran is a Dunmer mage and a member of House Telvanni residing in Sadrith Mora, on Vvardenfell. She can be found in the Council House's Council Audience Chamber.
Malgawn is a character residing in Ald Velothi, in Vvardenfell.

Manaad is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Erabenimsun Tribe, located in Ald'ruhn on Vvardenfell. As part of the celebration of Skar's defeat, he guards and prays to the cairn of the First Ashkhan of the Erabenimsun.
Maliah is a deceased Redguard whose body can be found in the Vale of Tiers in the Clockwork City.
Malacath Voidbringer is a generic Orsimer residing in Ashurnibibi in Vvardenfell. They are hostile to the Vestige and will attack upon sight.
Malacath Vanguard is a generic Orsimer residing in Ashurnibibi in Vvardenfell. They are hostile to the Vestige and will attack upon sight.
Malirndon is an Altmer fisher found at the southern docks of Shimmerene. He has no unique dialogue.
Maliren is an Altmer traveling merchant who walks between the bridge near Ebon Stadmont and Corgrad Wastes in Summerset.

Manacar is an Altmer hulkynd residing outside of Rellenthil. He lives in the wild with Cur, his only companion. When first encountered, he is poaching indrik off a Sapiarch's land so that the noble who hired him can serve its heart at a feast.
Maradem is a Redguard residing in Hallin's Stand. He is loyal to the Seventh Legion.
Maralie Rendar is a Dunmer member of the Rimmen Mages Guild in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. She is evidently very busy.
Many-Whispers is an Argonian found at the Swallowed Grove in Murkmire.
Manwe Tharam is a Dunmer residing in the Tribunal Temple in Ebonheart.
Manidah is a Redguard guild trader located at her store, Feast of the Sands, in Morwha's Bounty, Alik'r Desert, in .
Manabi Virith was a Dunmer smuggler found in the Isinfier Plains.
Manolos Virith was a Dunmer smuggler found in the Isinfier Plains.
Emperor Martin Septim, also known as Brother Martin or simply Martin, is the illegitimate son of Emperor Uriel Septim VII, and is the last Emperor and member of the Septim Dynasty.
Masalinie Merian is a Breton serving for the Balmora Mages Guild. She serves as the Guild Guide for this Guild hall. She has several spells that can be bought from her as well.

Marukh, sometimes spelt Maruhk, and also referred to as the Monkey Prophet or Prophet-Most-Simian, was an Imga prophet of the early First Era who was credited with founding the Alessian Order, a once popular monotheistic religion. He is commemorated every 9th of Second Seed on Marukh's Day, in which people remember his solemnity. Perhaps his most influential credo is seen in a famous quote of his "All are guilty until they have proven themselves innocent," a concept still based heavily in the legal system of modern Tamriel. Despite being an Imga, Marukh did not look up to elves the way his fellow Imga did; in fact Marukh and his Alessian Order despised elves to an extremity. While Marukh did
Mariana Ancharia is an Imperial hostess of the upscale Cheydinhal Bridge Inn. She rents beds for 40 a night, and sells a modest variety of food.
Massarapal is a Dunmer Trader living in Erabenimsun Camp, in Morrowind. Massarapal is a member of the Ashlanders faction.

Margarte is a Nord merchant in Leyawiin. She can be found either in the Great Chapel of Zenithar in Leyawiin, in her house directly across the street from the main entrance to the temple, or just outside the city collecting alchemical ingredients.
Marius Caro is the Count of Leyawiin. He is married to Countess Alessia Caro, who is also the daughter of Countess Arriana Valga of Chorrol.

Marinus Catiotus is an Imperial commoner living in his house in the Elven Gardens District. Marinus is a middle-classed man. He can occasionally be found at The King and Queen Tavern during the day. He will sometimes travel around Cyrodiil to places such as Anvil and Skingrad.
Marsus Tullius is an Imperial Trader who resides in Morrowind. He can be found in the wilderness to the northeast of Erabenimsun Camp.

Marcurio is an Imperial spellcaster in who resides in the Bee and Barb in Riften. He can be hired as a follower for 500 . After hiring him, and wearing an Amulet of Mara, Marcurio becomes a candidate for marriage.
Margret is a Nordic spy of the Imperial Legion, visiting Markarth.
Marise Aravel is a Dunmer merchant who makes her living selling meat in Riften. She lives in her house just off the lower level of the canal in Riften.
Mash gro-Burol is an Orsimer Warrior and Kinsman of House Hlaalu who lives in the Dren Plantation. He can be found in the Shipping House.

Maren the Seal is a Nord hunter and worshipper of the Daedric Prince Peryite. She is frozen in a trance that relates to the Daedric Prince's quest, but can be unfrozen in completion of the quest "Peryite." She is unable to be killed without finishing the Peryite quest. Maren wears Monk Robes, is armed with an Iron Dagger, and carries a few Septims.
Marlena Brussiner is an Imperial hunter residing in her home in the village of Hackdirt. Like all of the village's inhabitants, she is unfriendly to strangers.
Marthe Arthe is a hostile Breton sorcerer who resides in Mallapi.
Marilia Saram is a Dunmer bandit, and resides in the cave of Adanumuran, in the Ascadian Isles.
Maren Uvaren is a Dunmer merchant. She provides Enchanter services.
Marielle Amedee was a Breton healer who may be found in Shishi. She is found dead by the Nerevarine, presumably killed by the guards inside the ruins.
Marq is a Breton who thinks he is a goblin after they stole his special brew. He can be found outside Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai.
Maryse Trebane is a Breton who is found in the Beldama Wyrd camp near Tangle Rock in Glenumbra. She is a refugee from Camlorn.
Marthine Augier is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. She is the magister of their branch in Woodhearth.
Marquerite Etienne is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She is one of many that clean the city.
Marent Ergend is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He is found outside, near Edgard Gane and the Menoit's Emporium.

Marie Cergend is a Breton commoner who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found checking out the repairs near Winvale's Winsome Loom. She may also be found atop a wooden structure in the market area of Vivec City.
Marghrub is a Redguard residing on the island of Stros M'Kai, Hammerfell. He's found in Trelan Campsite, north of Saintsport.
Margot Oscent is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven, in . She is very worried upon first meeting her, as her son is missing.
Marlene Vanne is a Breton residing on Vanne Farm, in the region of Stormhaven. She and her brother, Phinis, have been sent there to work for a season for their aunt, Ingride Vanne.
Massour Asserrumusa is a Dunmer Scout and skill trainer residing near the coast in the region of West Gash.

Mark Jones was an artwork creator for many Elder Scrolls games. He is a part of IGDA (International Game Developer Association) since June 2010. "Welcome. I, Malthar, keeper of the Dragon's Eyrie will be your guide during your stay. I've bedded down the dragons so you're safe to explore. When not taking care of the Eyrie's dragons, Jones, my ward here at the Eyrie, can be found pushing pixels and pulling 'polys'. Within these pages you'll find a few of the dozens of games he has worked on over the last three decades, from DARKMERE, to the ELDER SCROLLS series, and beyond. Be sure to check back in the coming weeks...BIG CHANGES are coming to the Eyrie! So, Welcome to the Dragon's Eyrie, take
Master Llandresil is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Mournhold.
Marinus Jullalian is an Imperial part of the gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Belkarth.
Marz-Ja is an Argonian alchemist. She sells her wares at her apothecary, The Scalding Vial, in Sentinel.
Margine Gedanis is a Breton innkeeper. She runs the Anchor's Point Inn in Evermore.
Marlyn Hlaalu is a Dunmer member of House Hlaalu residing inside her house in Ebonheart.
Maronii Valas is a Dunmer found inside the dormitory of Shad Astula.
Markka is an Argonian residing in Hears-the-Wind's home in the city of Rawl'kha, Reaper's March.
Marchel Berard is a Breton laborer residing in the Lower Craglorn Pass in Dragonstar.
Marcius Cipius is an Imperial member of the Seventh Legion. He is one of their agents infiltrated in Evermore.
Marzul gro-Orgak is an Orsimer hall steward and a member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Shornhelm.
Marruz is a Dremora found in the Veteran City of Ash. She follows her master, Rukhan, into battle.
Master Ozalan is a Redguard who resides in the town of Hoarfrost Downs.
Marwig Bantien is a Breton residing in the city of Windhelm.
Master Glendora is a Breton mystic and a member of the Mages Guild residing in Windhelm. She can be found at the local branch, selling her wares.
Marnub is a Khajiit leatherworker. He sells his wares at his stall, Remarkable Leathers and More, inside the Elden Tree Armory in Elden Root.
Marostaale is an Altmer residing in Elden Root, the capital city of Valenwood in the Grahtwood region. He can be encountered in the garden in front of the Altmer Embassy.
Margaydeh is a Redguard moneylender residing in the Elden Root Outlaws Refuge.
Marinisuu is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Mabrigash Tribe. She is found at their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.
Marwyn is a Dunmer spirit and bard found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Marie Serielle is a Breton residing in the city of Northpoint.
Martialis Tharn is an Imperial member of House Tharn who can be found at the Do'Krin Monastery. He was sent by Javad Tharn to prevent the Vestige from obtaining the Golden Claw.
Marina Bincal is an Imperial residing inside her house in Cropsford, along with her husband, Octavimus Bincal.
Masna al-Satakalaam is a Redguard residing in the city of Haven.
Masarha is a Khajiit chef. She works at the Sundry Swills in Alten Corimont, Shadowfen.
Masbeshir is a Redguard tailor who works at the Lonesome Desert Tailors shop in the city of Orsinium.
Marineth is a Bosmer residing in the town of Geirmund's Hall, The Rift.
Marila Veren is a Dunmer clothier residing in Bleakrock Village on Bleakrock Isle. She has no unique dialogue.
Masdath is a Redguard residing in the Daggerfall Outlaws Refuge. He can be found next to the central scaffolding, and has no unique dialogue.
Martul is an Argonian clothier found in Bleakrock Village. Her class is "Clothier," but she is not a merchant, and has no unique dialogue.
Martinus Blasio is a traveling Imperial merchant. He is found on the road west of Driladan Pass.
Marches-Proud is an Argonian soldier of the Ebonheart Pact in who is stationed in Fort Zeren, Bal Foyen.
Master Altien is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Cave of Dreams.
Marsh-Wader is an Argonian residing in the Silent Mire, Deshaan.
Mareesh is a Redguard member of the Horsemen found in Silverhoof Vale.
Mariel the Ironhand is a wounded Bosmer found outside the ruins of Ilayas. She warns passersby about the situation taking place within.

Marilrin is a Bosmer found at several world event locations across Grahtwood. He is having a conflict with Serarbar, who ate a flower in violation of the Green Pact. Participating in their argument counts toward earning the "Peacemaker" achievement.
Marinora is a Bosmer Hunter, and member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found at Eagle's Strand.
Marise Salandas is a Bosmer commoner residing east of in Dhalmora at the beach where the Vestige and Bleakrock Isle Refugees arrive after the "Escape from Bleakrock" quest.
Marciele Bruhl is a Breton innkeeper and a member of the Lion Guard. She runs the Heroes' Encampment at the Bangkorai Garrison.
Maretta the Blood Maid is a Breton vampire working on behalf of House Montclair. She is found hiding inside a house in Northpoint after Lady Lleraya Montclair is defeated.
Margaud Vygant is a Breton member of the Daggerfall Covenant. She is found at the Southern High Rock Gate.
Margerelle Broc is a Breton brewer. She sells her wares in Shinji's Scarp.

Marisette is a Breton member of the Ring of Daggers. She is part of the small team tracking down the war criminal Gerard Althen, who worked as spymaster for King Ranser during his civil war against High King Emeric.
Marjacques Dauzat is a Breton fisher residing in Murcien's Hamlet.
Marnest Barclay is a Breton priest of Arkay. He is tending to the wounded and scarred at Camp Tamrith in Rivenspire.

Martin Dathieu is a Breton residing in Hoarfrost Downs. He is the son of the deceased General Dathieu, King Ranser's advisor and war commander up until his betrayal at the Traitor's Tor. He is one of the potential recruits for the Shornhelm City Guard in Hoarfrost Downs.
Martine Lerineaux is a Reachman of the Bloodthorn Cult. He is one of their many agents infiltrating Daggerfall.

Master Pellingare is a wealthy Breton noble residing in Wayrest. He is either found in his large manor or walking the streets, always accompanied by his personal bodyguard Gedric Serre. His children, Allene and Varaine, secretly lead a large gang of outlaws found within the sewers running beneath the city.
Marvyn the Chef is a Dunmer chef. He sells his wares and cooks for the soldiers in Jorunn's Stand.
Marenia Ancharia is an Imperial researcher. She is found at Kireth Vanos' camp north of Grudge-Rock Falls.
Marius is an Imperial found in the swamps south of the Hatching Pools. He has taken ill after inhaling some toxic fumes.
Marja Nuccius is an Imperial found at her farm north of Kvatch.
Margaud Donze is a Breton residing in Fort Amol. She can be found in between the Fighters and Mages Guild in the city.
Mareki is a Nord investigating, with the help of her brother Harnald, the presence of the Worm Cult at the Smokefrost Dragonshrine.
Marga Wind-Hill is a Nord that has taken shelter, like most of the other residents, within the Elinhir sewers away from the renegade Blackcaster Mages Guild.
Martha the Wench is a Nord merchant selling her wares only to pirates at the Blackheart Haven.
Master Kharekh gra-Bagrat is an Orsimer residing in Suran. Kharekh owned Master Kharek's Residence, a plantation nearby Suran.
Master Vilyn Arano is a Dunmer residing in Suran. He was the former owner of Arano Plantation.
Master Firuth is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni residing at the Hanud Tower in Vvardenfell. He endorses Sun-in-Shadow to be promoted in House Telvanni.
Markam Hawksmire was a head of the Order of the Hour. He was targeted by an assassin of the Dark Brotherhood and later killed.
Margrette Canne is a Breton member of the Mages Guild found in the guildhall in Shimmerene, Summerset.
Marianus Lentinus is a Breton found at the southern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Margus Derius is an Imperial black marketeer who is introduced as a competitor of the Cyrodilic Collections. __NOTOC__
Mariah is a Redguard in . As a landscaper, she carries a watering can and beautifies the park adjacent to Gerrick's Goods.
Marimah is a Redguard found at Morwha's Bounty in the Alik'r Desert. He is the leader of the Ash'abah tribe and the father of Talia at-Marimah.
Martin Gavinius is an elderly Breton enchanter on the run from the Thalmor. He is needed to find the ritual incantation to bind the Sorcerer-King.

Marinus Laeca is an Imperial residing at the Temple of the Ancestor Moths in Cyrodiil as an acolyte. He can be found by the storehouse of the Temple tending to the grounds and will speak to the Vestige when interacted with.
Marodeen is a Redguard researcher found in his house in the village of Vlastarus. He is the recipient of a Weathered Note during the quest "Best Left Unknown."
Marmalade is a monkey in . She resides in Numaia's ranch in the Prowl. She had her hand caught in a snare when Numaia found and rescued her.
Marcus Buca is an Imperial in who resides near the Hitch and Hostler Stables outside Leyawiin.
Mast is a Redguard servant in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.
Mareh the Hermit is a Redguard guide hired by Lady Clarisse Laurent on her trip to Qharroa Ruins. He can be found on a cliff northeast of the ruins.
Master Sulis is a Dunmer master of House Telvanni in . He hired the Morag Tong to find and assassinate a suspected spy among the Telvanni in Ald Isra.
Master Nadar is a Redguard located in Rahni'Za, School of Warriors, Craglorn, in .
Master Timen is a Redguard located in Rahni'Za, School of Warriors, Craglorn, in .
Master Malkhest is a character located in the Infinite Archive, Apocrypha, in .
Marcoryan Rirniel is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, located outside the Old Goat Inn.
Marthe Lemonds is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, in Stormhaven. She is the innkeeper at the Old Goat Inn, where her daughter is the chef.

Mathieu Bellamont is a Breton assassin in who resides within the cellar of the Anvil Lighthouse. He is the primary antagonist in the Dark Brotherhood quests. He is a long-serving member of the Dark Brotherhood, having joined the organization when he was a boy.
Mausur is a Dunmer Ashlander herder residing at the Ahemmusa Camp. He spends most of his time in Nummu's yurt or outside herding his tame guar.
Medila Indaren is a Dunmer Mage, and member of the Caldera Mages Guild. She has a number of spells for sale. She offers training in Destruction, Alteration, and Mysticism.
Mausur Ababael is a Dunmer miner working in the Gnisis Eggmine in Gnisis.
Maurrie Aurmine is a Breton noblewoman who may be found on the road between Balmora and Pelagiad.

Mebestian Ence is a Breton Trader, and merchant living in Pelagiad, Vvardenfell. He runs the local Trader shop, where he both lives and works. Mebestian is involved in the black-market Dwemer artifact trade, operating quietly right under the nose of the Imperial Legion. He wears expensive clothing, and carries a key.

Matthias Draconis is a Breton who works for Lord Umbacano. He is one of the children of Perennia Draconis. He guards Umbacano Manor in the Talos Plaza District, and has a house of his own just around the corner. He does not have much to say or do, except to fulfill his duties to Lord Umbacano. Matthias, along with the rest of the Draconis family, are targets of the Dark Brotherhood.

Matilde Petit is a Breton noblewoman in the "Whodunit?" quest. She is the first of whom the Hero meets and speaks to, she will try to befriend them in hopes of increasing her chances of walking away with something.
Matus Mido is an Imperial living in Ebonheart. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Maven Black-Briar is a Nord and the matriarch of clan Black-Briar. She will become Jarl of The Rift if the Imperial Legion occupies Riften.
Mecilvus Gabenagus is an Imperial assassin and bandit residing in the cave of Nund.

Meeko is a dog that can be located by the road to the south of Meeko's Shack in Hjaalmarch. Meeko is a follower, and looks like all other dogs. Recruiting him is achieved by walking up to Meeko then running after him back to Meeko's Shack, where he will look at his dead owner. If dismissed, Meeko will return to Meeko's Shack, even if the Dragonborn has purchased a home. With the addition of , it is possible to make Meeko a pet. This requires the Dragonborn to have adopted at least one child and to return to the house where their children are with Meeko as an active follower. Meeko will level with the Dragonborn up to level 25, where he will have 250 health. Prior to patch 1.6, his health and

Maul is a Nord and an associate of the Thieves Guild living in Riften. He is the righthand man of Maven Black-Briar, the matriarch of the Black-Briars. He is also the brother of Thieves Guild member Dirge. Once the player first enters Riften, Maul will warn the Dragonborn not to cause trouble. If Maven becomes Jarl of Riften, Maul will become her housecarl.
Maurice Jondrelle is a Breton pilgrim who is visiting many of the holy sites across Skyrim. He is involved in the quest The Blessings of Nature.
Medresi Dran is a Dunmer in who is encountered in Angarvunde.

Mavus Ules is a Dunmer and a member of House Hlaalu. He can be found at the Dren Plantation in the Ascadian Isles. He may be related to Nevena Ules, Malsa Ules, Ervis Ules, and Fathis Ules in Oblivion.
Mattius Wotrus is an Imperial who was sent to the Forsaken Mine in a unit of Fighters Guild warriors. He was sent to the mine in order to clear it of trolls, but was unable to successfully do so.

Mats was a Nord member of Moraelyn's Companions sometime during the First Era. Mats, also known informally as "Moraelyn's Slave," was a former slave freed by Moraelyn. Upon killing his former master, Moraelyn gave him some coins and told him that he was "free to go wherever he wished," but chose to travel with him instead.
Mavon Drenim is a Dunmer mage, and the spellwright of House Telvanni. He is located in the Telvanni Tower, in the Telvanni Canton of Vivec City.
Medrike is a Xivilai found in Mankar Camoran's Paradise. He guards the exit of the Forbidden Grotto. __NOTOC__
Meer is an Argonian Slave who is being held in the stronghold of Hlormaren.
Mavis Nadram is a Dunmer Drillmaster who can be found in the Indarys Manor in the Ashlands region.

Mathyn Bemis is a Dunmer Agent encountered in the Hlaalu Ancestral Vaults found in the Hlaalu Canton canalworks in Vivec City. He leads a group of outlaws who are defiling the tomb with their camp. There is a Morag Tong writ on his life.
Medresi Ofemalen is a Dunmer nightblade who resides in the Cave of Punsabanit.

Maximian Axius was an Imperial Legion soldier stationed in Fort Frostmoth under the command of General Falx Carius in the early Fourth Era. His skeletal remains can be found crushed under a pillar in the fort alongside his knapsack and several undelivered letters to his wife.
Mathis Dalobar is a Dunmer in Morrowind. Locating him is the goal of the House Redoran quest "Find Mathis Dalobar."
Meanen is an Altmer mage. He can be found at the company office in Caldera Mine.

Medyn Gilnith is a Dunmer sorcerer and retainer with House Telvanni. He resides at the Shishara tower in the Ashlands region, located south of the Aryon Ancestral Tomb, east of the Odaishah cave, and west of the Sanabi cave. Medyn is hostile towards anyone who is not a member of the House, and will readily engage in combat with any adversary in sight.
Matuk gro-Magrish is an Orsimer Barbarian residing in Habinbaes.
Mastrius is an Dunmer vampire located within the Salvel Ancestral Tomb.
Mausur Assaplit is a Dunmer Barbarian who can be found in a camp the Ashlands of Morrowind with Anasour Selitbael and Man-Ilu Ashananapal.
Mathesa Helvi is a Dunmer Scout and a member of the Camonna Tong with the rank of Bully who resides in her home on the Dren Plantation in the region of Ascadian Isles located within Morrowind.
Mazag is a Khajiit residing in the city of Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. He is typically found near the Mudcrab fights, reading.

Meema-Na is an Argonian ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed, and after the ghosts have returned to the temple. She cannot be interacted with.
Mazgro gro-Larishak is an Orsimer who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found northeast of the blacksmith forge, writing on a piece of paper.
Mavos Siloreth is an ancient Chimer mage who played an important role during the Nede-Chimer War. He was part of the team of mages who initially bounded Balreth to Ash Mountain.
Mathal is a Bosmer residing in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard.
Meerana is an Argonian merchant residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. She has a stall at the market near the docks, where she sells her wares.
Maxevain Narcien is a Breton, residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He is one of many citizens who keep the city clean.
Mazirul is a Khajiit warrior residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Mathilde Gidric is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. She is found hanging outside Councilor Theodore's House when the Vestige arrive.
Maxelle is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found standing near Daggerfall Millworks listening to Crier Martine.
Mathon al-Rihad is a Redguard residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. He can be found hanging around the Town Square.
Mazorn gro-Gar is an Orsimer warrior residing in the Gandrung Caverns.
Maxine Courcelles is a Breton noble residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She can be found sitting in the Wayrest Treasury waiting to get a loan.
Mathis Uveran is a Dunmer chef working at The Watch House in Davon's Watch.
Meensuda is an Argonian who resides in Davon's Watch in Stonefalls. He can be found at the Dockyards.
Mazil-jo is a Khajiit mystic in who sells his wares at his stall, The Eldritch Seal, at The Mercantile in Skywatch.
Mazradiir is a Khajiit in Skywatch, in the region of Auridon.
Matbia is a Khajiit who can be found in Mistral, Khenarthi's Roost. She cannot be interacted with.
Mazu is a Khajiit warrior residing in the port city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost. She has no unique dialogue.
Mednil Girith is a Dunmer banker working in the City Center of Mournhold.
Mathon Nosebreaker is a Nord mystic. He sells his wares at his stall, Rough-Cut Arcana, at the Belkarth Bazaar in Belkarth.
Masura-dra is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Sentinel.
Maxille Celiane is a Breton banker found at the Bank of Evermore in the city of Evermore.
Medilia Darothren is a Dunmer outside the registrar office in Shad Astula. She has no unique dialogue.
Maziar is a character residing in the city of Bergama in the Alik'r Desert.
Mazzeb al-Miran is a Redguard residing in the city of Evermore.
